text:
Alice Chen: Cutting RC candidate v1.12.0-rc.1 now. Artifact gcr.io/redwood/release:v1.12.0-rc.1 sha256:0a1b2c3d... Requesting sign-off for a 30m canary window starting 2024-08-21T15:00Z. cc @Ravi @Ben @Maria
Ravi Patel: Quick checklist - smoke tests ✅, migrations flagged? (no) ✅, infra config diff looks small ✅. I ran the smoke locally, no obvious errors.
Ben Morales: Sending QA smokepack + perf harness links. Please confirm regression results. Also request pin before promo.
QA Bot: Smoke: PASS (5/5). Perf: PASS (p95 latency +3%). Regression: 2 low-sev text tokenization diffs (see https://qa/reports/736). No blocking issues.
Maria Gomez: Feature flags check: `new-embed` = OFF, `cheap-cache` = ON. Confirmed. Release notes brief: "improve embedding cache; minor tokenizer fix; rollback safe" — I'll draft full notes after signoff.
Ben Morales: Pinning request: please pin artifact to release-candidate channel before deploy. Rollback plan in case of regressions: promote `v1.11.7` back and clear kv cache. Commands:
``
./deploybot promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/release:v1.12.0-rc.1 --pin release-candidate
# rollback
./deploybot promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/release:v1.11.7 --force
```
Oncall-Sheriff: I'll take on-call watch for the window. If error-rate > 0.5% or latency p99 increases >200ms trigger rollback. Will post metric thresholds to thread.
Alice Chen: ok let's schedule. Ben can you trigger deploybot for canary start at 2024-08-21T15:00Z for 30m? Keep canary at 1% traffic then ramp to 10% if green.
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled by @Ben Morales. Canary window: 2024-08-21T15:00Z -> 2024-08-21T15:30Z. Initial traffic: 1%. Auto-hold on alerts: error_rate > 0.5% or p99>200ms.
Ravi Patel: noted. I'll run the A/B evaluator and watch model outputs for hallucination regressions in the first 10m.
Maria Gomez: release notes added to draft: https://docs/releases/1.12.0-rc.1.md
Ben Morales: Promo kicked off. Deploybot says canary is live. Quick sanity check: `/curl -H "x-release: rc" https://api.redwood.test/health` returns 200 for canary pods.
deploy-bot: Canary started. 1% traffic routed to v1.12.0-rc.1. Monitoring hooks live. Will post status updates every 5m or on alert.
SRE Oncall: Saw a small blip at +3m, error-rate 0.12% -> back to baseline. No action.
QA Bot: Running small regression probe now (prompt set A). ETA 7m.
Ben Morales: If all green at +15m, ramp to 10% and hand off final signoff.
Alice Chen: thumbs up. Everyone on call please react with :eyes: when you have read this.
Ravi Patel: :eyes:
Ben Morales: :eyes: 
Maria Gomez: :eyes:
Oncall-Sheriff: :eyes:
QA Bot: report: PASS (prompt set A), no regressions flagged.
Alice Chen: Final signoff to promote to prod at 2024-08-21T15:31Z if no alerts. If anyone vetoes, say so now.
Ravi Patel: No veto from infra side.
Ben Morales: No veto from release.
Maria Gomez: No veto, notes ready.
deploy-bot: Scheduled promotion to prod at 2024-08-21T15:31Z. Will pin artifact to stable on success.
SRE Oncall: I'll keep watching the 30m after prod promo for traction. If rollback needed, use the rollback command above.
Alice Chen: Thanks team — cutting RC -> promo on schedule. :rocket:
